Repo: d:\_ntu台大\futureclass_未來教室\_dev\FutureClassroom (.NET 10 backend, Hangfire job service, Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL via EF Core). This is a READ-ONLY research task — do not modify any files.

I'm planning a new feature: after a student logs in (via NTU SAML SSO), the system needs to fetch and store their "final course selection result" (選課結果) from an external API, then filter which courses the student/teacher sees based on this data. I need to understand exactly how to wire this into the existing backend architecture.

Please investigate and report back:

1. `src/FutureClassroom.Core/Data/AppDbContext.cs` — full content. How are DbSets registered, how are entity relationships/indexes/unique constraints configured (look at Course and Lesson configuration as examples)?

2. `src/FutureClassroom.Core/Data/Course.cs` and `src/FutureClassroom.Core/Data/Lesson.cs` — full content (exact field types/nullability).

3. `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Migrations/` — list the last 3-4 migration files (just filenames + class names) so I understand naming convention. Read the most recent one fully as an example of the EF migration pattern used (Up/Down methods).

4. `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Services/CourseService.cs` (and `LessonService.cs` if it exists) — full content. How does `GetCoursesAsync` currently query/return data? What would need to change to filter by a student's enrolled courses or a teacher's own courses?

5. `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Services/DepartmentService.cs` — briefly, just to see the general Service class pattern (DI registration, how it's constructed) used in this codebase, since I'll likely add a new "EnrollmentService" or similar.

6. How are Services and DbContext registered in `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Program.cs`? (DI setup, AddDbContextFactory vs AddDbContext, etc.)

7. `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Auth/Saml2CookieManager.cs` full content, and check `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Program.cs` for how cookie auth / claims / options are configured — I need to know if there's a clean place to add a new claim or a new cookie for a "course-network OAuth token" once the student obtains one, and how the "8 hour cookie expiry" is configured (mentioned by a previous investigation).

Report file paths, class/method names, and relevant code snippets (not entire dumps, just the load-bearing parts). Organize under the 7 headings above.

47	            .GroupBy(r => r.CourseKey)
48	            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => new
49	            {
50	                Total = g.Count(),
51	                Completed = g.Count(r => lessonIdsWithAnalysis.Contains(r.LessonId))
52	            });
53

78	    {
79	        var course = await db.Courses
80	            .Where(c => c.CourseKey == courseKey)
81	            .FirstOrDefaultAsync()
82	            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Course not found: {courseKey}");
83

85	            .Where(l => l.CourseKey == courseKey)

88	            .ToListAsync();

90	        var isFallbackSchedule = rawLessons.Count == 0;
91	        List<LessonSummaryDto> lessons;
92	
93	        if (!isFallbackSchedule)
94	        {
95	            var lessonIds = rawLessons.Select(l => l.LessonId).ToList();
96	            var aiResults = await db.AiResults
97	                .Where(r => lessonIds.Contains(r.LessonId))

100	
101	            // "Completed" means the analysis result (AiWindows/AiWindowSeats) actually
102	            // exists — not whether a screenshot thumbnail happens to have been
103	            // generated yet (that's a separate, unrelated background job).
104	            var lessonIdsWithAnalysis = (await db.AiWindows
105	                .Where(w => lessonIds.Contains(w.LessonId))
106	                .Select(w => w.LessonId)
107	                .Distinct()
108	                .ToListAsync())
109	                .ToHashSet();
110	
111	            lessons = rawLessons.Select(l =>
112	            {
113	                var status = LessonEnum.LessonStatus.pending;
114	                string? lastUpdatedAt = null;
115	
116	                if (aiResults.TryGetValue(l.LessonId, out var ai))
117	                {
118	                    status = lessonIdsWithAnalysis.Contains(l.LessonId) ? LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed : LessonEnum.LessonStatus.analyzing;
119	                    lastUpdatedAt = status == LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed ? ai.UpdatedAt.ToString("o") : null;
120	                }
121	
122	                return new LessonSummaryDto(
123	                    LessonId: l.LessonId,
124	                    WeekNumber: l.WeekNumber,
125	                    LessonDate: l.LessonDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),

130	            }).ToList();
131	        }

138	            // what the ingestion endpoint uses to build LessonId in the first place

141	            var fallbackResults = await db.AiResults

143	                .Select(r => new { r.LessonId, r.Week, r.LessonDate, r.GeneratedAt, r.UpdatedAt })

145	
146	            var fallbackLessonIds = fallbackResults.Select(r => r.LessonId).ToList();
147	            var fallbackLessonIdsWithAnalysis = (await db.AiWindows
148	                .Where(w => fallbackLessonIds.Contains(w.LessonId))

150	                .Distinct()
151	                .ToListAsync())
152	                .ToHashSet();
153	
154	            lessons = fallbackResults
155	                .Select(r =>
156	                {
157	                    var status = fallbackLessonIdsWithAnalysis.Contains(r.LessonId) ? LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed : LessonEnum.LessonStatus.analyzing;
158	                    var lessonDate = r.LessonDate ?? DateOnly.FromDateTime(r.GeneratedAt!.Value);
159	
160	                    return new LessonSummaryDto(
161	                        LessonId: r.LessonId,
162	                        WeekNumber: int.TryParse(r.Week, out var week) ? week : 0,
163	                        LessonDate: lessonDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
164	                        Topic: null,
165	                        Status: status.ToString(),
166	                        LastUpdatedAt: status == LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed ? r.UpdatedAt.ToString("o") : null
167	                    );
168	                })
169	                .OrderBy(l => l.LessonDate)

171	        }
172	
173	        var schedules = course.SchedulesJson is null
174	            ? []
175	            : JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<CourseScheduleDto>>(course.SchedulesJson, _caseInsensitive) ?? [];
176	
177	        return new CourseLessonsResponse(
178	            CourseId: course.CourseId,

182	            CourseKey: courseKey,
